name: durable-saga
description: An executable saga definition for a multi-service order and payment flow, with compensation, a pivot, delayed callbacks, manual repair, generated diagrams, and a failure-matrix runner scored by an auditor that never ran the saga. Companion lab for Article 18.

scripts.test: node --test tests/definition.test.ts tests/forward.test.ts tests/compensation.test.ts tests/callbacks.test.ts tests/cancel.test.ts tests/manual.test.ts tests/version.test.ts tests/audit.test.ts tests/matrix.test.ts tests/diagram.test.ts tests/controls.test.ts
